g.text: Paired differences on common 2020–2025 target days
Source: sealed aggregate export. Conditional 95% intervals: 2,000 paired calendar28-day bootstrap draws within block-start year, seed20261030.
Every replica and method shares each resample; repeated dates are not treated as independent observations. Point-score wins are separate from interval inference.
